arXiv:2606.02337v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 6 月 1 日arXiv:2606.02337v1 [cs.AI] 01 Jun 2026

约束多智能体强化学习的协调图Coordination Graphs for Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

Santiago Amaya-Corredor1, Miguel Calvo-Fullana1, Anders Jonsson1
摘要Abstract

约束多智能体强化学习 (CMARL) 面临两个相互交织的挑战： 联合行动空间随着智能体数量呈指数增长，并且 额外的要求以单独奖励结构的方式耦合代理 不捕获。我们引入了约束多智能体强化学习的协调图（CG-CMARL），这是一个解决这两个问题的框架 通过将协调图与拉格朗日对偶性相结合来应对挑战。系统将联合问题分解为成对区域， 每个模型都由一组共享的 Q 函数提供服务，一个用于主要目标，一个用于每个约束，因此学习模型的数量独立于代理的数量。在执行时， 最大和消息传递协调因子图中的动作， 而拉格朗日乘子控制目标约束 权衡，允许单个经过训练的模型无需重新训练即可追踪帕累托前沿。我们在温和的条件下提供收敛保证，并提供 分解为单独的可解释源的组合误差界限，每个源都可追溯到特定的设计选择并且可独立控制。合作导航任务的实验（其中最多 10 个代理的团队必须协调才能到达目标位置，同时满足成对约束）表明，我们的方法产生的帕累托前沿支配着以固定奖励塑造比率训练的既定基线，同时扩展到团队规模，其中集中式方法变得难以处理。Constrained Multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL) faces two intertwined challenges: the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of agents, and additional requirements couple agents in ways that reward structure alone does not capture. We introduce Coordination Graphs for Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CG-CMARL), a framework that addresses both challenges by combining coordination graphs with Lagrangian duality. The system decomposes the joint problem into pairwise regions, each served by a set of shared Q-functions, one for the primary objective and one for each of the constraints, so that the number of learned models is independent of the number of agents. At execution time, Max-Sum message passing coordinates actions across the factor graph, while a Lagrangian multiplier controls the objective–constraint tradeoff, allowing a single trained model to trace a Pareto front without retraining. We provide convergence guarantees under mild conditions, together with a compositional error bound that decomposes into separate interpretable sources, each traceable to a specific design choice and independently controllable. Experiments on cooperative navigation tasks (where teams of up to 10 agents must coordinate to reach target positions while satisfying pairwise constraints) show that our method produces Pareto fronts dominating established baselines trained at fixed reward-shaping ratios, while scaling to team sizes where centralized approaches become intractable.

1 简介Introduction

多智能体强化学习（MARL）已成为一种强大的 在多个系统中进行顺序决策的框架 自治代理必须协调他们的 行动Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has emerged as a powerful framework for sequential decision-making in systems where multiple autonomous agents must coordinate their actions(zhang2021multiagent; albrecht2024marl)。一个中央 挑战是. A central challenge is可扩展性scalability：联合行动空间扩大 代理数量呈指数增长，呈现集中化 即使对于中等规模的团队来说，这种方法也很棘手。为了解决这个问题， 分解的 MDP: the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of agents, rendering centralized approaches intractable even for moderate team sizes. To address this, factored MDPs(boutilier2000factored)和协调 图表and coordination graphs(guestrin2002contextspecific; kok2006collaborative)利用代理交互的局部性，分解全局 价值函数分解为区域成分并降低复杂性 代理数量呈指数增长，最大规模呈指数增长 互动组。消息传递算法，例如 最大和exploit the locality of agent interactions, decomposing the global value function into regional components and reducing complexity from exponential in the number of agents to exponential in the size of the largest interacting group. Message-passing algorithms such as Max-Sum(farinelli2008decentralised; rogers2011bounded)那么 无需集中计算即可实现分布式动作协调。then enable distributed action coordination without centralized computation.

许多多智能体任务还额外施加Many multi-agent tasks additionally impose安全限制safety constraints不能用奖励来交换。避免碰撞、能量 必须执行预算和带宽限制。约束马尔可夫 决策过程 (CMDP)that cannot be traded off against reward. Collision avoidance, energy budgets, and bandwidth limits must be enforced. Constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs)(altman1999constrained)形式化 这样的规格。对于单代理设置，原始对偶方法 基于拉格朗日松弛法已经证明 有效的formalize such specifications. For single-agent settings, primal-dual methods based on Lagrangian relaxation have proven effective(tessler2018reward; paternain2023safe)，以及最近的 工作已确定 CMDP 在温和条件下表现出零对偶差距 条件, and recent work has established that CMDPs exhibit zero duality gap under mild conditions(paternain2019constrained).

然而，将约束强化学习扩展到多智能体设置 引入了现有方法无法充分解决的挑战。 集中式原对偶方法需要访问全局状态 和联合行动空间，正是影响方法的瓶颈 旨在克服。独立学习者无法协调约束 满意度：如果每个智能体独立优化自己的拉格朗日量， 团队可能集体违反全局约束。核心 困难在于However, extending constrained RL to the multi-agent setting introduces challenges that existing methods do not adequately address. Centralized primal-dual approaches require access to the global state and joint action space, precisely the bottleneck that factored methods aim to overcome. Independent learners cannot coordinate constraint satisfaction: if each agent optimizes its own Lagrangian independently, the team may collectively violate global constraints. The core difficulty is that约束耦合代理constraints couple agents以这样的方式 奖励结构本身并不能捕捉到这一点。据我们所知， 先前的工作没有结合因子价值函数的可扩展性 具有拉格朗日方法的约束处理能力 具有收敛保证的去中心化架构。in ways that reward structure alone does not capture. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work combines the scalability of factored value functions with the constraint-handling capabilities of Lagrangian methods in a decentralized architecture with convergence guarantees.

3.3 拉格朗日约束处理Lagrangian Constraint Handling

我们采用拉格朗日松弛来处理 约束条件 (We adopt a Lagrangian relaxation to handle the constraints in (2）。拉格朗日量为：). The Lagrangian is:

4 理论分析Theoretical Analysis

我们建立了 CG-CMARL 的收敛性和近似性质。 该分析解决了两个问题：算法是否收敛于 有意义的解决方案，以及这个解决方案离真正的解决方案有多远 最优？所有证明均推迟至附录We establish convergence and approximation properties of CG-CMARL. The analysis addresses two questions: does the algorithm converge to a meaningful solution, and how far is this solution from the true optimum? All proofs are deferred to Appendix9.

我们与跨越不同设计轴的五种方法进行比较： IQL（独立 Q 学习），训练每个智能体的 Q 函数 不协调； QMIXWe compare against five methods spanning different design axes: IQL (Independent Q-Learning), which trains per-agent Q-functions without coordination; QMIX(rashid2018qmix)，它通过代理 Q 网络结合 以全局状态为条件的单调混合网络； 直流电导率, which combines agent Q-networks via a monotonic mixing network conditioned on global state; DCG(bohmer2020deep)，它使用协调图，但是 无约束处理； MAPPO，具有共享奖励的多智能体 PPO 基线；和 MAPPO-拉格朗日，用拉格朗日乘子扩展 MAPPO 为满足约束条件。 对于基于值的方法（IQL、QMIX、DCG），覆盖安全性 权衡由碰撞惩罚混合比控制, which uses coordination graphs but without constraint handling; MAPPO, a multi-agent PPO baseline with shared rewards; and MAPPO-Lagrangian, which extends MAPPO with a Lagrangian multiplier for constraint satisfaction. For the value-based methods (IQL, QMIX, DCG), the coverage-safety tradeoff is controlled by the collision-penalty mixing ratioα∈{0.0,0.3,0.6}\alpha\in\{0.0,0.3,0.6\}，因此每个经过训练的模型都会产生一个操作点。 MAPPO 接受过培训 相同的混合比配置并同样产生 每个模型一分。 MAPPO-拉格朗日学习自己的乘数 在训练期间，但是这个乘数被冻结在受过训练的演员中 并且不能事后改变，所以它也产生一个点。在 相比之下，CG-CMARL 从受过训练的人那里追踪完整的帕累托前沿 扫掠模型, so each trained model yields a single operating point. MAPPO is trained with the same mixing ratio configurations and likewise produces one point per model. MAPPO-Lagrangian learns its own multiplier during training, but this multiplier is frozen in the trained actor and cannot be varied post-hoc, so it too yields a single point. In contrast, CG-CMARL traces the full Pareto front from one trained model by sweepingλ\lambda在评估时，解耦 训练的约束权衡。at evaluation time, decoupling the constraint tradeoff from training.

This advantage arises from two sources. First, the two Q-function architecture decouples coverage and safety learning, avoiding the interference that occurs when collision penalties are mixed into the reward. Second, Max-Sum coordination enables agents to jointly avoid collisions rather than treating them as independent per-agent penalties.

CG-CMARL’s advantage at this scale lies in providing a reliable, low-variance Pareto front from a single model, rather than requiring multiple independently trained models with uncertain outcomes.

6 结论Conclusion

协调图和拉格朗日约束处理地址 合作 MARL 中的互补挑战：可扩展性和安全性， 分别。 CG-CMARL 通过维护两个 Q 函数来集成两者 每个区域，通过参数共享在所有成对区域之间共享， 分别预测主要奖励和约束奖励。扫除拉格朗日乘数Coordination graphs and Lagrangian constraint handling address complementary challenges in cooperative MARL: scalability and safety, respectively. CG-CMARL integrates both by maintaining two Q-functions per region, shared across all pairwise regions via parameter sharing, that separately predict primary reward and constraint reward. Sweeping the Lagrangian multiplierλ\lambda在评估时追踪 来自单一训练模型的全面覆盖——安全帕累托前沿。 最大和消息传递协调因子图中的动作， 具有代理数量的复杂性多项式。at evaluation time traces the full coverage–safety Pareto front from a single trained model. Max-Sum message passing coordinates actions across the factor graph, with complexity polynomial in the number of agents.

成本 Q 函数评估初级贪婪策略，产生 真实拉格朗日的保守近似。我们另外 讨论了一个The cost Q-function evaluates the primary-greedy policy, yielding a conservative approximation to the true Lagrangian. We additionally discussed aλ\lambda-增强配方 （节-augmented formulation (Section3.1）产生自洽成本 通过调节 Q 函数进行预测) that produces self-consistent cost predictions by conditioning the Q-function onλ\lambda期间 训练，但代价是增加样本复杂性。 Simple Spread 协作导航任务的实验 多达 10 个代理表明 CG-CMARL 的帕累托前沿主导了所有代理 基线，中等球队的优势最为明显 协调图相对于稀疏的大小 问题结构。我们还提供了收敛保证 在独立转换和奖励因子分解下，以及 分解为四个可解释的组合错误界限 来源。during training, at the cost of increased sample complexity. Experiments on the Simple Spread cooperative navigation task with up to 10 agents show that CG-CMARL’s Pareto front dominates all baselines, with the advantage most pronounced at moderate team sizes where the coordination graph is sparse relative to the problem structure. We additionally provided convergence guarantees under independent transitions and reward factorization, together with a compositional error bound that decomposes into four interpretable sources.

8.1 完整的伪代码Complete Pseudocode

算法Algorithm2呈现完整的 CG-CMARL 培训 程序。在每个时间步，算法都会构建区域感知 观察，通过增强上的阻尼最大和来协调动作 Q表，收集经验，并更新共享的双方头 Q-网络。在每集结束时，局部拉格朗日乘数为 根据观察到的约束奖励通过双重上升进行更新。presents the full CG-CMARL training procedure. At each time step, the algorithm builds region-aware observations, coordinates actions via damped Max-Sum on the augmented Q-tables, collects experience, and updates both heads of the shared Q-network. At the end of each episode, local Lagrange multipliers are updated via dual ascent based on observed constraint rewards.

评估协议。Evaluation Protocol.

在评估时，训练好的 Q 网络被冻结，拉格朗日 乘数At evaluation time, the trained Q-network is frozen and the Lagrangian multiplierλ\lambda是外部设置的（未学习）。对于每个值is set externally (not learned). For each valueλ∈{0,0.1,0.2,0.5,1,2,5,10}\lambda\in\{0,0.1,0.2,0.5,1,2,5,10\}，模型为 对多个事件进行评估，记录平均覆盖率和 碰撞率。该程序追踪覆盖范围-安全帕累托前沿 来自单个经过训练的模型，无需重新训练。, the model is evaluated over multiple episodes, recording average coverage and collision rate. This procedure traces the coverage–safety Pareto front from a single trained model without retraining.

This averaging serves two purposes: (i) it ensures all regions use a common augmented Q-function, which is necessary for Max-Sum to optimize a consistent objective; and (ii) it pools local constraint observations across agents, providing a more accurate estimate of team-wide constraint satisfaction.
